01_raw_placeholders.png: Initial EDA: literal sentinel and blank counts before cleaning.
02_raw_season_volume.png: Initial EDA: calendar length and entry counts change across seasons.
03_duplicate_cleaning_effect.png: Before/after EDA: deterministic driver-race deduplication and target prevalence.
04_missingness_cleaning_effect.png: Before/after EDA: parsing changes representation, without fabricating observed values.
05_qualifying_coverage.png: Coverage evidence: historical qualifying absence motivates period restriction and missing-value indicators.
06_typed_qualifying_duration.png: Semantic typing: lap-time strings converted to seconds; tail truncation is display-only, no raw records removed.
q1_frontrow_circuits.png: Front-row podium conversion by circuit and era on the same eligible races, excluding recorded nonstarters; qualifying and grid definitions use two starters per race. Bars are descriptive 95% Wilson intervals and plotted circuits have at least 20 starts per cell.
q1_era_changes.png: Change in actual-grid front-row podium conversion from 1994–2013 to 2014–2024 for the same circuit identities, with at least 20 observed starts in each era. Calendar changes, cars and field composition prevent causal attribution to hybrid rules.
q2_home_advantage.png: Home-country and away-country driver-entry podium probabilities in 1994–2024, before and after standardization to the same exact grid-position × era distribution. Intervals use 1,000 whole-race bootstrap resamples; adjusted estimates apply only to shared-support strata, and are associational.
q3_constructor_reliability.png: Recorded mechanical causes with laps below winner distance, divided by driver starts by constructor ID and era. Positive-lap withdrawals remain starts; explicit withdrawal/nonqualifying labels exclude entries only without positive laps. Bars show descriptive 95% Wilson intervals; orange crosses add ambiguous causes under the same early-end gate. Ranking requires at least 40 starts and does not merge renamed teams.
10_chronological_split.png: Race-grouped chronological split: same-race entries stay together; prevalence measures class imbalance.
11_feature_evidence.png: Training-only feature evidence: missingness and univariate association are descriptive, not causal or independent effects.
12_feature_effects.png: Feature motivation: training podium rates by grid and strictly shifted driver form.
13_feature_correlation.png: Correlated predictors motivate regularized logistic regression and grouped ablation; importance can be shared among correlated features.
neural_learning_curve.png: Lab-style Keras History plots: training/validation loss and exact validation AP. EarlyStopping restores the maximum validation-AP weights.
feature_group_ablation.png: Validation-only ablation of every feature group, with fixed logistic hyperparameters and unchanged rows. Improvements after removal are also shown.
preprocessing_order_distributions.png: Training distributions for A (a feature with actual missing values) and B (a continuous range). All binary/missingness flags are protected from clipping; all statistics are training-only.
training_window_sensitivity.png: Validation-only 1994 versus 2003 training-window sensitivity, using fixed logistic hyperparameters and validation rows. Era, sample size and qualifying coverage all change together.
holdout_curves.png: 2022-2024 ROC and precision-recall curves of all three frozen models; model choice uses validation AP only.
holdout_confusion_matrix.png: Holdout confusion matrix for the validation-selected model and its frozen validation-F1 threshold.
permutation_importance.png: Global validation permutation importance of original inputs, scored through the frozen preprocessing/model. Bars are eight seeded AP-loss shuffles; error bars are sample SD.
shap_global.png: Global SHAP for the validation-selected Shallow neural network; season-proportional seeded validation sample (2019: 21, 2020: 17, 2021: 22). The separately selected local case does not enter global summaries. Attribution units: podium probability (Kernel SHAP approximation); background is training-only.
shap_local_waterfall.png: Local SHAP waterfall for the validation probability nearest 0.5, selected without consulting its true label. The same case is explained with LIME.
lime_local.png: LIME on the same validation case as local SHAP. Conditions are imputed original-unit values with binary flags; a wrapper applies frozen scaling. The title reports local surrogate R-squared.
